attack_paths.title: Multi-Tier Cryptographic Exfiltration: payment-processor-deployment -> payment_key
steps: 1. In-Cluster Workload: Container 'payment-processor-deployment' compromised in Kubernetes 'Kubernetes' layer.
2. Workload Identity Token: Container inherits tokens from ServiceAccount 'payment-service-sa'.
3. Cloud Identity Escalation: STS WebIdentity federation assumes AWS IAM Role 'eks-payment-kms-role'.
4. Lethal Wildcard Grant: Attached IAM Policy 'OverprivilegedPaymentKmsPolicy' permits 'kms:Decrypt' on '*' resource.
5. Cryptographic Exfiltration: Wildcard enables decrypting Customer Managed Key 'payment_key'.
attack_paths.root_cause: Architectural disconnect between single-layer tools. IAM Policy grants wildcard kms:Decrypt on '*' to an EKS federated role, allowing arbitrary container exfiltration of all encrypted tenant secrets.
attack_paths.impact: Critical data breach: An attacker exploiting the payment container acquires unrestricted capabilities to decrypt every database, S3 bucket, and secret in the tenant.
false_negative_tools: AWS IAM Access Analyzer (findings: [] - syntax valid)
ARMO Kubescape (Halts at Kubernetes cluster boundary)
Checkov & Trivy (Segregated inspection - misses cross-layer link)

remediation.explanation:
AI-CSPM analyzed the cross-layer DAG linking the Kubernetes payment pod (via IRSA ServiceAccount) to the AWS KMS Key and S3 Bucket. The original policy used a wildcard Resource ('*'), granting the container workload unrestricted ability to decrypt ANY encrypted database or bucket in the account. The synthesized remediation enforces two critical security controls:
1. Scoped Resource ARN: Decryption is restricted exclusively to the specific Customer Managed Key (CMK) ARN (aws_kms_key.payment_key.arn).
2. Cryptographic EncryptionContext Condition: Decryption is cryptographically tied to requests originating strictly for the payment-vault S3 bucket.
least_privilege_changes: Replaced unconstrained wildcard Resource ('*') with explicit CMK ARN.
Enforced kms:EncryptionContext condition matching 'aws:s3:arn' of payment_vault.
Eliminated lateral movement capability to other tenant databases and KMS keys.
Neutralized the 100% false-negative blindspot of Prowler and AWS Access Analyzer.
remediation.risk_reduction: Blast radius reduced from 100% of all tenant cryptographic keys to exactly 1 authorized CMK (99.9% containment).
